notes.title: SILVER DAZE DEMO - SPECIAL NEXT FEST UPDATE
notes.notes: [p]IT'S FINALLY TIME! Welcome to Next Fest! I hope you guys get to find some awesome new games! [/p][p]The Silver Daze Demo is getting an exclusive new update to celebrate![/p][p][/p][p]This update features exclusive content that isn't present in the full game, which you'll be able to transfer up when Silver Daze releases![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/68d96456d29edf624a508a7de4da83411c6e2700.png"][/img][/p][p]Once you beat the main story of the demo, simply exit Geo's Room and a short scene will play, prompting you where to go next.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/ea75788468f3dd7710a3ceb9a2e723edbc8ca5c0.png"][/img][/p][p]You'll be able to explore a new type of dungeon called a ReCollection, where you'll be given challenges to wager points![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/535359de578ed5c167a632759432ad5fdb7fcbaa.png"][/img][/p][p]Explore this dungeon to hunt down enemies and rack up points, completing challenges to get big multipliers![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/3d101512edab362c8324101a68d7c3a877268898.png"][/img][/p][p]Then once you reach the end, you can spend those points to obtain rare cards, including the Demo Exclusive "GoddessTear"![/p][p][/p][p]I hope you guys enjoy this new demo content, and look forward to playing Silver Daze when it releases! See you soon![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.16.0
notes.notes:
-Improved prologue audio sync
-Enemies now drop all cards when A Ranked
-Holding A speeds up MP3 notifications
-Improved healing formula
-Miscellaneous bug fixes

notes.title: PATCH 0.15.5
notes.notes:
-Repaired AOE loudness issue
-Repairs to Card Binder count
-Improved cutscene transitions

We're still working hard! Expect a February report with some cool new features soon!

notes.title: Patch 0.14.4
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES:
-Changes to EP costs on leveled cards
-Added Color icon to enemies and allies in battle
-Repaired Shiny Rates
-Repaired playtime
-Added secret chests


The biggest change this patch is the introduction of color icons! Now, highlighting an enemy or ally while selecting them for an attack will display an icon telling you the enemy's color!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/2fdc1f00d43804851120c22cd305db325b549782.png[/img]

In addition, some players experienced problems with the likelihood of finding Foil enemies. This has been repaired.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Patch 0.13.6
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES:
-Music Menu in Geo's Room now persists after closing menu
-Repaired game over music bug
-Changes to certain card names
-Stability changes
-Shop "Sell" page is now sorted by quantity of cards
-Created ReCollection Files 

These new features are an excellent byproduct to our ongoing development of the full game! Please don't forget to leave a review on the demo if you haven't already!
